scene: You step off the garden tram into the airy Bonsai Sky Nursery.
picture: Pixel art side-scrolling terrace under clear sky. On the far left sits the open green garden tram. The grandfather stands on a moss path beside his loaded plant bicycle. At the centre rises a giant potted bonsai pine. Up high hovers a brass watering drone. On the far right stands a smoking tea shed.
shown: a rustic cedar tea shed with steaming chimney on the far right
a gnarled giant pine bonsai in a stone dish at the centre
a brass watering drone hovering with twin misting nozzles up high

variants.scene: Cool twilight mist settles as the garden tram clicks gently to a halt.
You smell fresh pine needles while still searching everywhere for {quest}.
A whirring brass contraption showers green boughs against the purple evening sky.
